worldcombat.skill.flail.summary: Flails left and right in turn around the current aim: the lower the user's HP, the more swings and the heavier each one, and everything caught in the fan is swept and shoved. It can be aimed at a direction or swung at nothing, and keeps swinging even after the original target dies. Reckless style hits harder but wounds the user on every swing.
worldcombat.skill.flail.use.0: Unload a whole flurry when badly hurt
worldcombat.skill.flail.use.1: Sweep everyone pressed into the fan in front
worldcombat.skill.flail.use.2: Shove a pursuer off your face
worldcombat.skill.flail.use.3: Make a last stand when the health bar is nearly gone
worldcombat.skill.flail.description.0: Flails across the fan in front: each swing deals about %1$s damage, and lower HP means more swings (about %2$s now). The target's Defence, type and crit are settled on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.flail.description.1: Each swing reaches %1$s blocks and opens %2$s degrees, with about %3$s s between swings; the first is offset 35° left of the aim, the second 35° right, alternating, and it never turns to follow the original target.
worldcombat.skill.flail.reckless.on: Reckless style on: each swing deals ×1.25 and you swing ×1.35 as often, but every swing - even a miss - costs about %1$s of your maximum health.
worldcombat.skill.flail.reckless.off: Steady style: no self-damage, but fewer swings at lower power.
worldcombat.skill.flail.timing: Cast on a target within %1$s blocks; casting takes %2$s s of wind-up and %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown that starts on cast.
worldcombat.skill.flail.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown drops to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.flail.preference.reckl: On: each swing deals ×1.25 and you swing ×1.35 as often, but each swing costs a little of your maximum health and can finish you at low HP. Off (steady): no self-damage, but fewer swings at lower power.
worldcombat.skill.flail.preference.ai.ma: Beyond this the companion walks in instead of flailing; higher opens earlier but mostly whiffs, since this is a melee move.
worldcombat.skill.flail.preference.ai.fi: On: raises Flail's order against a target under 35%% of its health, to close it out; off ranks only by how hurt the companion is.
worldcombat.skill.flail.preference.ai.re: With reckless style on, the companion stops flailing below this health fraction so self-damage cannot finish it. Higher is more cautious.
worldcombat.skill.flail.description.push: Each foe in the fan is struck once per swing; a foe that is hit is shoved about %1$s blocks away from the user.
